pokedexEntries.bk: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

pokedexEntries.wh: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

pokedexEntries.us: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

pokedexEntries.um: It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a certain territory that it never leaves its whole life long.

pokedexEntries.sw: As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s concrete pillars.

pokedexEntries.sh: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
